comment: Every ledger on the curated Fluree server, not only fibo-v2: a stray write creates a new ledger as readily as it advances a known one.
The v2 schema the examples read. .env names the v1 'public' schema; the v2 names live only in ccf_dataprep/ccf/config.py (CLAUDE.md section 9).
The v2 Mongo database. CCF_TEST_MONGO_URI is the DISPOSABLE variable and is fenced by the write guard; this is the curated read.
